Vile Mother (Demon)
Flesh Spawner, Stygian Hag, Grotesque

No one knows from where these sickening beasts came, but it is universally wished that they would return to that undoubtedly foul pit. As if dealing massive damage with their razor sharp claws were not enough, they also spawn smaller - but no less violent - offspring to rend the flesh from the bones of their victims.

Tips and Other Additional Information
Kill Vile Mothers as fast as possible to prevent them from creating more deadly children.
